_description: PR 6 seed. UK post-punk scene + hip-hop crossover. Direct-ingest bands: 4 UK post-punk (Joy Division, New Order, The Fall, Gang of Four) + 6 hip-hop (Beastie Boys, LL Cool J, Sir Mix-a-Lot, Run-DMC, RATM, Public Enemy). Anthrax already in graph from PR 3 (metal cluster) so its hip-hop collabs (I'm the Man, Bring the Noise, Judgment Night soundtrack) will bridge naturally via Chuck D and Public Enemy. Note: 7 new common-name overrides added since JD/NO/Fall/GoF/PE/Run-DMC all have MB namesakes.
